messages.subject: Re: leaflet in shiny
parts:
You used input$degre outside of reactive expressions or observers:

if(is.null(input$degre)){return()}

data<-reactiveValues({switch(input$degre,

That is not allowed. You can put them inside renderLeaflet({...}).
BTW, I don't think you need reactiveValues() for `data` when you put
this inside renderLeaflet().

Regards,
Yihui
